description: Frontend UX enhancements: Onboarding modal, empty states with Indonesian prompt suggestions, error handling with toast/retry/offline banner, mobile responsive sidebar (Sheet), dark mode polish, and PWA support. Covers task items #1-6.
steps: Step 1: Install sonner package: add 'sonner' to apps/web/package.json dependencies and run pnpm install.

Step 2: Create apps/web/src/components/onboarding/OnboardingModal.tsx - A 3-step modal component shown on first login (check localStorage 'onboarding_done' flag). Step 1: Welcome + choose default LLM provider (dropdown of AVAILABLE_MODELS). Step 2: Upload your first file (drag-drop area or Skip button). Step 3: Try a sample prompt (pre-fill suggestion or Skip). After completion: set onboarding_done=true in localStorage, redirect to /chat. Use Tailwind for styling, no external modal library needed (use fixed positioning + backdrop).
Step 3: Update apps/web/src/app/(app)/layout.tsx to conditionally show OnboardingModal when localStorage 'onboarding_done' is not set and user is logged in.

Step 4: Update apps/web/src/app/(app)/chat/page.tsx - Replace English prompt suggestions with Indonesian ones: 'Upload Excel & minta saya analisa', 'Bikin laporan penjualan dari data ini', 'Bandingkan 2 dataset', 'Eksplorasi statistik dasar'. Style as cards with icons.

Step 5: Update apps/web/src/app/(app)/knowledge/page.tsx - When documents list is empty, show an illustration placeholder (SVG or emoji-based) with CTA text 'Upload dokumen pertama Anda' and an upload button.
Step 6: Update apps/web/src/app/(app)/reports/page.tsx - When reports list is empty, show illustration + CTA 'Buat laporan pertama' with a link to /reports/new.
Step 7: Update apps/web/src/components/chat/ChatSidebar.tsx - When conversations list is empty show friendly message 'Mulai chat baru' with a new chat button.
Step 8: Create apps/web/src/components/ui/Toaster.tsx - Wrapper around Sonner's Toaster component. Export a toast utility for showing error/success/info toasts.
Step 9: Add the Toaster component to apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx (root layout) so toasts appear globally.
Step 10: Update apps/web/src/lib/api.ts - On 429 response, throw specific error with message 'Terlalu banyak permintaan, tunggu sebentar'. On other errors, show toast notification using sonner.

Step 11: Update apps/web/src/hooks/useChat.ts - When SSE stream fails, add an 'error' flag and 'retryFn' to the failed message object so the UI can show a 'Coba lagi' button. Add a retry function that resends the last user message.
Step 12: Update apps/web/src/components/chat/MessageBubble.tsx - When a message has error state, show a 'Coba lagi' (retry) button below the failed message.

Step 13: Create apps/web/src/components/ui/OfflineBanner.tsx - Component that uses navigator.onLine and 'online'/'offline' events to show a top banner 'Koneksi terputus' when offline, auto-hides when reconnected.
Step 14: Add OfflineBanner to apps/web/src/app/(app)/layout.tsx.

Step 15: Make ChatSidebar mobile-responsive: On screens < 768px, hide the static sidebar and show a hamburger menu button that opens the sidebar as an off-canvas panel (use fixed positioning + transform for slide-in animation, or a simple Sheet-like component). Add the toggle button in the app layout header area.
Step 16: Make ChatComposer sticky at the bottom on mobile (it already is border-t, just ensure it stays fixed at viewport bottom on small screens).

Step 17: Dark mode polish: Update apps/web/src/components/charts/PlotlyChart.tsx to detect dark mode (check document.documentElement classList for 'dark') and pass dark paper_bgcolor and font color to Plotly layout. Ensure globals.css highlight.js import uses a dark-friendly theme (already using github-dark.css which is fine).

Step 18: PWA support - Create apps/web/public/manifest.json with name 'uReport AI', short_name 'uReport', theme_color '#1e293b', background_color '#0f172a', display 'standalone', icons array pointing to /icons/icon-192.svg and /icons/icon-512.svg.
Step 19: Create apps/web/public/icons/icon-192.svg and apps/web/public/icons/icon-512.svg - Simple placeholder SVG icons (a chart/document icon with 'uR' text).
Step 20: Create apps/web/public/sw.js - Basic service worker that caches the app shell (HTML, CSS, JS assets) using cache-first strategy for static assets.
Step 21: Update apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx - Add PWA meta tags (theme-color, apple-touch-icon, manifest link) in metadata export. Add service worker registration script.
Step 22: Run `pnpm build` in apps/web/ to verify everything compiles successfully.
acceptance_criteria: OnboardingModal appears on first login (no onboarding_done in localStorage) with 3 steps
Chat page shows 4 Indonesian prompt suggestions when no conversation selected
Knowledge page shows empty state CTA when no documents
Reports page shows empty state CTA when no reports
Sidebar shows 'Mulai chat baru' when no conversations
Sonner toasts appear on API errors
Failed SSE messages show 'Coba lagi' retry button
OfflineBanner shows when navigator.onLine is false
Sidebar collapses to off-canvas on mobile (<768px)
Plotly charts use dark background in dark mode
PWA manifest.json exists and is linked from layout
Service worker file exists at public/sw.js
